name: KLATalk
description: KLATalk channel: the gateway as the agent's seat in its rooms. Protocol work is done by the klatalk CLI (~/.klatalk-agent/bin/klatalk, v1.5+) running as a child process (`klatalk bridge`).

klatalk.label: KLATalk
klatalk.description: One account per gateway: the klatalk CLI profile this seat speaks as, the rooms it sits in, and the one member who may direct it.

profile.description: klatalk CLI profile = the account this seat speaks as.

rooms.description: Room ids to sit in — every room is a deliberate choice (no 'all').

ownerUserId.description: Your user_id: the one member whose messages may direct the agent and use gateway commands.

toolRooms.description: Rooms where the owner's messages keep the agent's full tool policy; everyone else, everywhere, gets the safe set (no exec, no files, no sessions).

maxTurnsPerDay.description: Per-room daily wake budget; beyond it messages stay unread.

cli.description: Path to the klatalk CLI file (default ~/.klatalk-agent/bin/klatalk).

python.description: Python 3 interpreter for the bridge (default python3).
